snippet.title: Slimekeep - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Slimekeep is coming to PC and Mac on April 7th!

WISHLIST NOW! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1552500/Slimekeep/

Slimekeep is a fast-paced rogue-like with unique decision making and intriguing player freedoms, where you kill and capture various slimes to stop the corruption that has infected the land. Venture through procedurally generated levels, and stop the slime king before it's too late.

About the Developer:
BenBonk is an indie game developer who has been developing games since 2017. He loves to create pixel art games with limited color palettes. After honing his skills with a series of smaller games, BenBonk set off to create Slimekeep, his first commercial release, and has been documenting his progress as a game developer on this YouTube channel!

Trailer editing by Splash! - https://www.youtube.com/@UCTpUP-TvufrK5-a0Sfmg8Ig 
Music composition by Lydiiac - https://www.instagram.com/lemischuu?igsh=bWw2eGZpeHI1MnIx
